title: Require Public Domain Surfaces In Tests
forbids: test files deep-importing domain internals instead of the aggregate contract/router, nearest model owners, or module artifact catalogs
why: Tests exercise domain behavior through the same named aggregate and evidence surfaces as product code. Test location alone does not grant access to module operations, rules, or private implementations.
remediate: Replace each violating test import with a public domain surface only after the corresponding domain public surface exists. Do not widen a domain public surface merely to satisfy a test.
message: Use the domain root/router, nearest model atoms or policy, and module artifact catalogs instead of domain internals.
